title: Garlic and Ginger Pastes

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: Fresh pastes used in most recipes here. Jarred versions taste of preservatives.

steps.action: Blend with just a little water into a paste:

sub: About 5 medium garlic cloves, peeled, per 1 Tbsp
About 1 cu in ginger, roughly chopped, per 1 Tbsp

items: When a recipe calls for both, blend them together

edits: Source ratios are inconsistent: the spice list says 5 garlic cloves and 1 cu in ginger per Tbsp; Aloo Gosht says 6 cloves and 2 cu in
